ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.8 focuses on locating the real source of JobGiver spikes before expanding production parallelism. The on-demand bounded JobGiver capture now measures WorkGiver callbacks together with GenClosest, Reachability, RegionTraverser and PotentialWorkThings/PotentialWorkCells enumeration infrastructure, keeps the slowest outer TryIssueJobPackage traces, and reports their top inclusive phases. These diagnostic detours exist only during the 32-package capture and are automatically removed afterward. V0.4.7's fail-closed hauling fast paths, V0.4.6 Work search accelerator, bounded Path shadow validation, PathGrid invalidation deduplication, late-stale protection, and validated Butter++ logical-tick barrier are retained. Gameplay remains Vanilla-authoritative for unsupported, stale or incompatible calls.
